WITH p AS (SELECT DATE '2025-08-25' AS d1, DATE '2025-09-21' AS d2),
sales AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (f.receipt_id, f.line_no) f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.store_key, f.net_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f, p WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN p.d1 AND p.d2
  ORDER BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.etl_loaded_at),
sales_by_store AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, sum(x.net_amount) AS sales_net FROM sales x JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = x.store_key GROUP BY 1),
returns_by_store AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) AS refunds_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key, p
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN p.d1 AND p.d2 GROUP BY 1),
stores AS (SELECT store_id, store_name, region FROM dim_store, p WHERE p.d2 BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to AND store_id < 900)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 5 AS fiscal_period,
  rank() OVER (ORDER BY coalesce(a.sales_net,0) - coalesce(b.refunds_net,0) DESC) AS rank,
  st.store_id, st.store_name, st.region,
  round(coalesce(a.sales_net,0) - coalesce(b.refunds_net,0), 2) AS net_sales_eur
FROM stores st LEFT JOIN sales_by_store a USING (store_id) LEFT JOIN returns_by_store b USING (store_id)
ORDER BY rank
